system.description:
You target a metal item, causing it to rust and erode at an exponential rate.

Choose an enemy within 10 spaces. Any non-magical weapons and armor they possess rust and decay until the start of your next turn.

Until the spell ends, if the target hits on an attack with a metal weapon, it shatters. The weapon is treated as an Improvised Weapon for any further attacks.

Additionally, if the target of the spell is attacked, their Armour is permanently reduced by the Damage dealt. If this reduces their Armor to 0, their Armor is destroyed.

You can also use this to destroy other non-magical metal items, such as wheels or door hinges. If they are used while they are affected by this spell, they break.

Each extra success extends the duration by +1 rounds.
